name: Karolina
headline: Turn Viaplay’s viewing data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells subscription plans, family offers, live sports, series and movies to every visitor in the same way, whether they are new or already watching.

What your viewers watch, finish, pause and never open is the strongest signal you have for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for sports, series, movies and family plans are built by hand, per segment, per month. The viewer about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per subscriber, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per subscriber from viewing patterns, pauses and support contacts across sports, series and movies. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each subscriber and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right plan to each subscriber
cases.text: Next best plan or add-on per subscriber, triggered by what they actually watch. No more blanket upgrade mails to people already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every subscriber watching every week
cases.text: Personal nudges to sports, series, movies and original shows, in email, push and on your homepage, orchestrated so each subscriber has a reason to watch again this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
